svg.aria-label: Logging food, Packaged food, Goals and progress, Water and pills, AI assistant, Habits, Diary (Mini App), Design and reliability

text.tspan: Logging food
Dish recognition from a photo: foods, grams and
macros per 100 g
A photo caption works as a hint: “this is 200 g of
rice”
Log by text: “ate 2 eggs and toast”
Edit the name or grams and the AI recalculates
macros
Delete entries in one tap
Packaged food
Photo of a nutrition label: the bot copies the values
exactly
Barcode reading and lookup in Open Food Facts
Or just send the barcode digits
Goals and progress
A 6-question survey and a daily target by the
Mifflin–St Jeor formula
Goals: lose weight, maintain or gain muscle
Daily and weekly summaries: eaten, left, where you
went over
Weight tracking with a chart and automatic target
updates
Water and pills
Water target of 30 ml per kg of body weight, +250
and +500 ml buttons
Reminders every 30 minutes to 2 hours, quiet at
night
Vitamins and medicines by time of intake
“Taken”, “In 30 min” and “Skip” buttons
AI assistant
“What to eat”: 3 options that fit your remaining
calories and protein
Any option goes into the diary with one button
Weekly review with a score, praise and 3 tips
Answers to nutrition questions that take your
target into account
Habits
A daily streak you won’t want to break
13 achievements: streaks, days on target, water,
labels, weight
Celebration animations when you hit your target
Diary (Mini App)
Calorie ring, week calendar and week chart, macro
cards with hints
Water glass with a wave and ±250 ml buttons
Log food by text, including past days
Light and dark theme
Design and reliability
Its own icon set, FITTER Icons
Automatic fallback to a backup Gemini model
24-second AI timeout: a clear reply instead of
endless loading
A daily request limit protects the free quota
